verdict: Yes. maisha from Ahmedabad pitched handmade cotton and jacquard bags on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Cotton and jute bags replace plastic and sell to shoppers and to businesses for corporate gifting and events.
angle: Handmade cotton and jute bags are in demand from buyers avoiding plastic and from companies ordering branded bags. Women's self-help groups and tailoring units can make them. Corporate orders can be large.
